answer: Locks are logged in vault, expire in comet, and falcon lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 22 aliases therefore needs 145 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 900 identities would post 593 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
